title: Fix the E′ round-4 review findings: Linux /proc permission scan, credential-manager cache daemon, cleanup refusal wording, and Windows-only portable tests
outcome: Fix the E′ round-4 review findings: Linux /proc permission scan, credential-manager cache daemon, cleanup refusal wording, and Windows-only portable tests
acceptance: On Linux, a /proc entry of a process outside the runner's own group that cannot be opened or read for lack of permission (EACCES/EPERM, e.g. hidepid=1 or an LSM denial) no longer aborts the membership snapshot: a successful Git command still returns its result, its cleanup is still proved, and no reservation is retained for it. The existing refusal stays for a real failure to observe the runner's own group. A test exercises the permission-denied case.

A Git Credential Manager helper configured to use its cache credential store (credential.credentialStore or GCM_CREDENTIAL_STORE = cache) is refused before any Git process starts, like the bare cache helper. The refusal names the store setting and how to change it. A test covers it; plaintext and keychain stores keep their current behaviour.

When the operation deadline is reached and cleanup then fails, the refusal reports the Deadline interruption and the cleanup failure each once. It no longer reports the same Cleanup detail twice or claims the run was interrupted by itself.

A launch refused because the pending-cleanup capacity is full has its own wording without reservation or proof claims, and every Cleanup refusal names its remedy: end the listed group's survivors, then restart the Engram process.

A failure to launch the Unix runner keeps a sanitized phase and OS error code, distinguishing a missing Git executable, a denied executable and a failed thread or pipe setup, and names a corrective action.

These portable real-Git tests run on macOS and Linux as well as Windows: inspected_exchange_matches_exact_git_blobs_and_refuses_branch_target_and_tree_drift (admission tests), the checkpoint_tests evidence committed module, delta_commit_and_progress_observe_abandoned_git_before_the_writer, delta_resolution_and_retry_keep_abandoned_git_outside_the_writer, and the delta deferred writer retired module including a_carrier_fetched_for_a_held_scope_refusal_is_abandoned_by_audit_and_the_hold_resolves. They pass on all three platforms.
Strict clippy and the focused tests covering these changes pass on Windows, macOS and Linux on one exact candidate commit whose sole parent is the current master.

completion.summary: Delivered E′ round-five repairs on exact clean 9449ba31039b3fb16dcbba5c7f74e42e6228d27a/tree 116aec7816b9e11c6d66fca786e029ce2603ba0c: independent Linux group membership checks for unreadable stat, GCM cache refusal, distinct deadline/capacity/Unix launch diagnostics, and six portable real-Git test groups. Strict Clippy and focused behavior passed on Windows/macOS/Linux (14/30/31). Independent acceptance 99713998a5c042f890459a23a57fce58 passed all seven criteria against the same source. Manifest f6c6c37106f3401bbef397334d88f8ae retains exact original evidence. Local candidate and native records remain available to the open parent; Opus owns its whole-input review, FULL and landing.
